subject: Information Theory
title: Load Balancing
description: Learn Load Balancing in one minute.

hook.text: Google handles 100,000 searches per second. No single server could survive that. The load is split across millions.

buildup.text: Load balancing distributes requests across multiple servers so no single machine is overwhelmed.

discovery.text: Algorithms range from round-robin to weighted least connections to consistent hashing for cache-friendly distribution.

twist.text: The power of two choices: randomly picking two servers and choosing the less loaded one dramatically reduces queuing.

climax.text: Load balancing applies Shannon's insight: spread information across channels to approach total capacity.

punchline.text: Share the work, survive the storm. Balance is scalability.

quiz.question: What problem does load balancing solve?
options: Distributing requests so no single server is overwhelmed
